database: Tiger Cloud (TimescaleDB) regulation database, read through the backend API (GET /api/v1/regulations/{provision_id})
method: Each provision was found by its clause key or text and read in the database before linking. 'exact' = the clause the rule checks; 'related' = guidance or a neighbouring clause, shown because the rule's own source is not loaded. Links are evidence for engineer review: they never change a rule value or a pass/fail result, which come only from the deterministic checker.
loaded_instruments: SOLAS Chapter II-2 (MCA publication of the chapter in force 1 July 2002, with MCA guidance; 'summary' availability), 2010 ADA Standards (full text), 71 DNV class guidelines (DNV-CG-*, not the DNV ship rules RU-SHIP). FSS Code, IGF Code, IGC Code, Load Lines, MARPOL and IACS URs are not loaded.

SOLAS-II-2-13-DEADEND-PAX.note: Difference for review: the loaded text contains no 13 m figure. II-2/13/3.1.2 prohibits dead-end corridors, except in service areas separated from crew accommodation and inaccessible from passenger accommodation. The rule's 13 m value is unchanged (it stays unverified).

SOLAS-II-2-13-DEADEND-CARGO.note: Same figure as the rule: more than 7 m not accepted.

ADA-403.5.1.note: Same figure as the rule: 36 inches (915 mm) minimum, with the exceptions in the text.

ADA-404.2.3.note: Same figure as the rule: 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.
